name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For safety, `ptr` must still own the potential weak reference represented by the raw pointer; pointers originating from `Weak::new` are exempt from owning a weak reference because they own nothing.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Weak < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express ownership of a weak reference or whether a pointer originated from `Weak::new`. No equivalent Boolean expression is representable.
